features.name: Classical substitution ciphers
features.description: Encrypt and decrypt with Caesar (with a live cipher wheel), ROT13, ROT47, Atbash, Affine, Baconian, A1Z26 and a full custom Substitution alphabet.
features.notes: All client-side; mode select (encrypt/decrypt) per tool

features.name: Polyalphabetic & keyword ciphers
features.description: Vigenère and Beaufort drive the shift from a repeating keyword for stronger classical encryption.
features.notes: Keyword input; non-letters passed through

features.name: Transposition & grid ciphers
features.description: Rail Fence (zigzag), Scytale and Polybius rearrange or grid-map letters rather than substituting them.
features.notes: Rail-fence and Polybius show a live visual grid

features.name: XOR cipher
features.description: Byte-level XOR of text against a key — the building block of modern stream ciphers.
features.notes: Hex/key handling in-browser

features.name: Cryptographic hashing
features.description: Compute MD5 and SHA-1/256/384/512 fingerprints of any text.
features.notes: SHA via the browser's native Web Crypto API; MD5 implemented from scratch

features.name: Cryptanalysis toolkit
features.description: Letter Frequency Analysis (bar chart), Index of Coincidence, and a Cipher Auto-Solver that fingerprints the likely cipher and auto-cracks simple ones.
features.notes: Auto-Solver uses IoC + chi-squared scoring of all 26 Caesar shifts + format heuristics

features.name: Base encodings
features.description: Base64, Base64 URL-safe, Base32, Base58 and ASCII85 encode/decode for binary-safe text.
features.notes: Base64 uses native btoa/atob over a UTF-8 byte view

features.name: Number-base text encodings
features.description: Hexadecimal and Binary representations of text, both directions.
features.notes: Round-trips arbitrary text

features.name: Web encodings
features.description: URL percent-encoding, HTML entity encoding, and Unicode code-point conversion for safe web/markup handling.
features.notes: Handles emoji and accented characters

features.name: Signalling alphabets
features.description: Morse code, NATO phonetic alphabet, and Tap code translate text to/from human/signal alphabets.
features.notes: Full Morse map incl. punctuation; word separators preserved

features.name: Number theory
features.description: Prime test & factors, large-integer Factorization, GCD/LCM, and Modular Inverse — the maths behind real cryptography.
features.notes: Factorization uses BigInt with Miller-Rabin + Pollard's rho

features.name: Number representation
features.description: Base Converter (any base 2-36), Roman Numerals, and Number-to-Words spelling.
features.notes: Bilingual word output (EN/PT)

features.name: Sequences & combinatorics
features.description: Factorial, Fibonacci, Combinatorics (nCr / nPr), and the Quadratic equation solver.
features.notes: BigInt where values grow large

features.name: Everyday calculators
features.description: Statistics (mean/median/mode/stdev), Percentage, and Temperature conversion.
features.notes: Instant, live recompute on input

features.name: Lottery odds calculator
features.description: Compute the true odds of matching each prize tier in a 'pick k from n' lottery, with exact combination counts.
features.notes: BigInt combinatorics; links out to the QI LotteryWiz app

features.name: Covering wheel
features.description: Generate a reduced set of tickets that guarantees coverage of a chosen pool of numbers.
features.notes: Shares combinatorics helpers with the odds tool

features.name: Transform & clean
features.description: Case Converter, Reverse, Leet Speak, Clean Whitespace and Slugify reshape text for any need.
features.notes: Slugify strips accents via NFD normalisation

features.name: Analyse
features.description: Text Statistics (chars/words/lines/sentences) and Word Frequency surface the shape of a body of text.

features.name: List operations
features.description: Sort Lines, Remove Duplicates and Find & Replace operate line-by-line on pasted lists.

features.name: Generate
features.description: Lorem Ipsum placeholder text generator for mock-ups and design.

features.name: Fully bilingual (EN / PT)
features.description: Every label, tool, option and educational article switches between English and Brazilian Portuguese with one toggle, instantly, no reload.
features.notes: Loc {en,pt} pairs throughout; language persisted in localStorage

features.name: 100% offline & private
features.description: Everything runs in the browser. No data ever leaves the device and the app keeps working with no internet, installable as a PWA.
features.notes: vite-plugin-pwa service worker; static build, no backend needed for the tools

features.name: Instant search & favorites
features.description: Search all 59 tools by name or description across categories; star favourites to pin them to the top.
features.notes: Favorites persisted in localStorage

features.name: Learn-as-you-go content
features.description: Each tool carries a 'How it works' explainer plus history, trivia and a source link — a teaching toolbox, not just a calculator.
features.notes: Bilingual educational layer attached by tool id

features.name: Live visuals
features.description: Selected tools render a live diagram as you type — the Caesar cipher wheel, Polybius 5x5 grid, rail-fence zigzag and substitution mapping strips.
features.notes: SVG/HTML generated from current inputs

features.name: On-device assistant
features.description: Ask in plain language ('is there a tool for palindromes?') and the assistant points you to the right tool — running entirely on your device.
features.notes: TF-IDF retrieval over the bilingual tool index; synonym + de-pluralisation expansion

features.name: Dark / light theme
features.description: Switch between dark and light themes; the choice is remembered.
features.notes: CSS variables, data-theme attribute

features.name: Cloud assistant (optional)
features.description: The assistant can be pointed at a hosted endpoint for richer answers when CypherMiner is published — switched purely by config.
features.notes: Cloud provider implemented; cloudEndpoint not configured, local offline mode is the default

features.name: QI module contract API
features.description: Exposes the standard QI endpoints /health, /version and /info so QI Hive Mission Control can monitor it.
features.notes: FastAPI on port 8502; /info returns the registry self-description

features.name: Registry-driven CORS
features.description: Allowed origins are read from the QI ecosystem registry rather than hardcoded, so sibling QI projects are trusted automatically.
features.notes: QI.cors_origins() with a safe localhost fallback

features.name: 24/7 services + public tunnel
features.description: Runs as Windows services and is reachable remotely at a permanent URL via a static Cloudflare named tunnel.
features.notes: QI_CypherMinerAPI + QI_CypherMinerUI + QI_CypherMinerTunnel -> https://cypher.quiddityinnovations.com

features.name: Registered in QI ecosystem
features.description: Listed in qi_registry.json with ports 8502/7842 (blocks 8500-8599 / 7840-7849), path and status.
features.notes: family_tier: sibling
